problemSummary: Dashboard shows blank page after bridge restart
approach: Cleared browser cache and hard-reloaded, assuming a stale service worker cached the old bundle
failureReason: The blank page was caused by the agent-service being down, not browser caching — the dashboard kept showing 'server offline' because the socket never connected

problemSummary: Revising knowledge records through /knowledge/propose while the agent-service runs stale code — record-level title/problemSummary corrections are silently ignored and audit lines can be lost
approach: Proposed v2 revisions for EXP-000008..012 via scripts/revise-knowledge.mjs against the admin API without first confirming the service process had loaded the current knowledge.ts (the process had been started without --hot and predated the propose extension)
failureReason: Old code path ignored the new record-level ProposalInput fields (version content stored, record corrections lost until a v3 completion pass) and exposed the audit() persistence gap — 9 audit lines existed only in memory; 4 recovered, 5 lost (AUD-000036 documents it). Lesson: verify the service runs current code before batch mutations

problemSummary: Controlled persistence regression test: verify that a knowledge-store write acknowledged by the API is present on disk and survives a service restart (audit of the AUD-000036 incident class).
approach: Write this attempt record + its audit line via the admin API, confirm both on disk via read_file, restart the agent-service (production mode), re-sync, and verify both records still exist with identical IDs.
failureReason: n/a — infrastructure test record, not an engineering attempt
environment: user machine via bridge; agent-service production mode; post-fix persistDirty (dirty flags clear only on successful writes)
